verdict.rationale: Kling documents native audio co-generation that includes speech, priced tiers "with audio + voice control", and Elements that keep a character's voice consistent across shots, so generated characters can speak. The evidence never explicitly mentions lip-sync, mouth movement matched to audio, or speaking user-supplied dialogue or audio. Missing for 10: explicit lip-sync documentation, confirmation that user-written dialogue or uploaded audio drives the speech, hands-on or independent corroboration of lip-sync accuracy.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio
